svg.title: Online sharing offers visibility but can reduce control over an image.

text.tspan: Online sharing offers visibility but can reduce control over an image.
a double-edged sword
Something that brings an advantage while also creating a related
disadvantage or risk.
a mixed blessing; an advantage with a downside
Posting the party photos online is a double-edged sword: it spreads
the word, but guests may lose control of where their images appear.
Name both edges: a benefit and a cost of the same thing. Two
unrelated complaints do not demonstrate the idiom.
A: Last year’s photos brought in twice as many visitors. We should
post everything again.
B: Publicity is a double-edged sword. Some guests don’t want their
children’s faces online.
A: Could we use close-ups of the decorations instead?
B: Yes, and ask permission before including anyone identifiable.
Complete this balanced assessment with one benefit and one
drawback: “A public event hashtag is a double-edged sword: ___, yet
___.” Keep both points connected to public visibility. (Model: A public
event hashtag is a double-edged sword: it helps people discover the
event, yet it can expose participants’ photos to strangers.)
